Entrelinhas Bistô Bar

Our story

Founded in the heart of Alverca, the Entrelinhas bar was born from Ana and Luís's shared dream of creating a cozy space where the community could gather. The couple transformed an old neighborhood grocery store into a modern hangout spot, blending exposed brick walls with warm lighting to offer a relaxed setting after a long day of work.

Since its opening, the venue has stood out for its carefully curated craft beer selection and homemade tapas prepared from family recipes. Ana took charge of management with her welcoming smile, while Luís took care of the music selection and live performance nights, turning the bar into a local benchmark for good acoustics.

Today, Entrelinhas is much more than a simple bar in Alverca; it has become a cross-generational meeting point. Between lively conversations and weekend toasts, Ana and Luís's story continues to unfold in every corner, proving that life's best moments always happen between the lines of everyday routine.
